title: Federal learning method and system combining personalized differential privacy
assignee: University of Science and Technology of China USTC

pse.problem: Existing federal learning methods do not efficiently protect data privacy due to the exposure of model parameters and lack of personalized privacy requirements.
pse.solution_function: The invention introduces a federated learning method with personalized differential privacy that reduces the impact of the differential privacy mechanism on the model effect while meeting user-specific privacy requirements.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a server side and multiple user sides, each participating in a round of training. The method utilizes differential privacy to protect data privacy.
pse.solution_implementation: The server side selects user sides for the current round of training. The user sides apply the differential privacy mechanism during model updates, reducing precision loss without compromising personalized privacy requirements.
pse.effect: This solution provides improved data privacy protection and reduces precision loss in federated learning scenarios.
